reason: A browser-integrated upload plugin that stores files and folders locally and makes text, paths, and supported images available in the conversation.

summaries.zh: 通过浏览器工具菜单上传文件或文件夹，将文本内容、文件路径和支持的图片加入对话。
summaries.en: Upload files or folders from the browser and add text content, file paths, and supported images to the conversation.

capabilities: uploads files and folders through a browser interface
writes uploaded content to local disk
injects text previews and file paths into the conversation composer
attaches supported images as message content
